About Ting-Yu

Business context shapes the question. Data helps me make the answer useful.

I’m Ting-Yu (Patrick) Chang, a business and data analyst with a background in marketing and economics. I combine commercial experience with analytics to make business information useful for decisions.

At Pro-Racing Industry Inc., I build reporting with Power BI and SQL and present insights to leadership. My graduate work with Avanath added client-facing analytics experience, while earlier marketing work shaped my understanding of customers and buyers.
